blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the numbers that are solutions of negative three x plus four is less than or equal to thirteen.
blocks.display: Select all the numbers that are solutions of −3x + 4 ≤ 13.

blocks.text: Negative four. No: negative three times negative four is twelve, plus four is sixteen, which is more than thirteen.
Negative three. Yes: negative three times negative three is nine, plus four is thirteen, and thirteen is less than or equal to thirteen.
Zero. Yes: negative three times zero is zero, plus four is four, which is less than thirteen.
Two. Yes: negative three times two is negative six, plus four is negative two, which is less than thirteen.
Negative five. No: negative three times negative five is fifteen, plus four is nineteen, which is more than thirteen.
Negative three, zero, and two are solutions: the solutions are x greater than or equal to negative three. Negative four and negative five give more than thirteen.
